title: Did Google's AI agents really build an operating system for $916? The importance of independent evaluation
author_or_organization: Stephan Rabanser, Sayash Kapoor, Rishi Bommasani, Andrew Schwartz, Arvind Narayanan (AI as Normal Technology)
limitations: Step-by-step technical deconstruction of high-profile vendor autonomous agent demonstrations, documenting hidden human interventions, prompt injections, repeated retries, and high operational costs. Highlights demo fragility, but represents single-case forensic observation rather than a randomized comparative benchmark.
